Your AI agent can manage your DNS. 🤖
The official DNSimple CLI was built for people and agents alike. Ask your agent to check which domains expire this month, renew one, or add a record, and it runs the same commands you would.

✅ Works in your terminal, your scripts, and your agent workflow
✅ Structured output that agents and pipelines can read
✅ Multi-account support with named contexts

See it in action and install it 👉 https://dnsimple.com/cli

#dns #cli #devops
